description:
FLOOR TWO, UNIT ONE

Voluminous full floor downtown living where Chelsea and Greenwich Village meet. Spanning the entire second floor with private outdoor space, this condo home retains up to 11-foot ceiling heights and grand proportions from the building’s pre-war origins.

Keyed elevator opens into the contemporary residence where five oversized south-facing windows stream light into the living, dining and kitchen area. The room’s nearly 25-foot width invites ample seating and entertaining space. The chef’s kitchen has marble counters, Valcucine Italian cabinetry, high end appliances and vented hood. A pantry and counter seating add extra storage and convenience. 

An impressive gallery hall leads to three bedrooms, two full baths and the terrace. One of the bedrooms has a skylight, double closet and en-suite entry to a full bath with Artelinea Italian double sinks and limestone floors. The other two bedrooms open out to the approx. 24 x 6 ft terrace, which is a quiet and leafy respite from the City. The primary bedroom suite has a skylight, dressing area and full bath with dual Artelinea vanity, limestone floors and walk-in shower. The second of these terrace-facing bedrooms is generous in size with double closet.

Unit One has an entry foyer with double coat closet, powder room, laundry room with vented washer & dryer and utility room. Central air, hardwood floors throughout. 

Situated on the southernmost edge of Chelsea, Greenwich Village unfolds right across the street, Union Square and the East Village are just to the east while Chelsea, Flatiron, and Meatpacking are just to the north and west. Grocers including Westside Market, Union Square Greenmarket and Whole Foods are within minutes. Subways on 6th and 7th Avenues are equidistant. West 14th Street is experiencing a redesign, with new condo development on the corners of 6th Avenue and the street’s busway has brought a residential side-street feel to what once was one of the City’s busiest streets.

Furnished photos are virtually staged. 

Broker fee and condo application fee. Contact us today to view.

This unique 2 bedroom is located in a picturesque brownstone in the heart of Chelsea. This first floor walk-up apartment spans almost 1,000 sq. ft. The apartment includes an open kitchen, dishwasher, 12ft high ceilings, a decorative fireplace, hardwood floors and ample closet space. 

Among the many highlights of this extraordinary home are dramatic double windows which open up to the street filling up your living space with sunshine. This grand room has a renovated open kitchen with an island and a beautiful decorative fireplace with original details dating back to the 19th century. 

The apartment features two bedrooms with built in bookcases with overszed windows in both rooms, a spacious bathroom and several closets with built in shelving and drawers for additional organization.

This truly is a one of a kind property located in one of Manhattans most coveted neighborhoods known for its architecture and rich  history. Traditionalists will appreciate Chelsea’s Historic Cushman Row, located between Ninth and Tenth Avenues on 20th Street. This brownstone is just steps away from this row of landmarked historic brownstones built by real estate spectaculaor Don Alonzo Cushman in 1840.

The neighborhood also has a modern appeal and is known for its art scene. During seasonal art openings Chelsea is buzzing with events in galleries surrounding the neighborhood. In addition Chelsea is home to popular attractions such as the Chelsea Piers, well renowned restaurants, great shopping and most recently the Highline.
